name: Connected Vehicle Telematics with Bluetooth Adapter (v2)
description: Connected-vehicle architecture baseline v1 extended with an aftermarket Bluetooth diagnostic adapter plugged into the OBD-II port.

components.name: Mobile App
components.description: Smartphone companion app for remote vehicle control, status monitoring, trip history, and OTA update notifications.

components.name: Cloud Backend
components.description: Cloud-hosted backend providing authentication, vehicle command relay, telemetry storage, user account management, and fleet analytics.

components.name: OTA Server
components.description: Dedicated server for firmware packaging, signing, distribution, and campaign management for over-the-air updates.

components.name: Telematics Control Unit (TCU)
components.description: Vehicle-side connectivity module providing cellular communication to the cloud, receiving remote commands, uploading telemetry, and managing OTA downloads.

components.name: Central Gateway ECU
components.description: Central routing and firewall ECU that interconnects all in-vehicle network domains (CAN, Ethernet) and enforces message-filtering policies between domains.

components.name: Infotainment ECU
components.description: In-vehicle infotainment system providing navigation, media, and connectivity features. Connected to the in-vehicle network for vehicle data display.

components.name: Body Control Module (BCM) ECU
components.description: ECU controlling body functions: door locks, windows, lights, horn, and other comfort/convenience features.

components.name: Powertrain ECU
components.description: Safety-critical ECU controlling engine management, transmission, and drivetrain functions.

components.name: Diagnostic Tester / OBD-II
components.description: External diagnostic tool connecting to the vehicle via the OBD-II port for fault reading, ECU programming, and calibration.

components.name: Aftermarket Bluetooth Diagnostic Adapter
components.description: Aftermarket dongle plugged into the OBD-II port communicating via Bluetooth with mobile devices and querying vehicle ECUs via OBD-II/CAN.

interfaces.name: Mobile-to-Cloud API
interfaces.description: RESTful API over HTTPS for user authentication, vehicle command submission, status queries, and trip history retrieval.

interfaces.name: Cloud-to-TCU Command Channel
interfaces.description: Encrypted MQTT channel for relaying remote commands (lock, unlock, engine start) from cloud to TCU.

interfaces.name: OTA Server-to-TCU Update Channel
interfaces.description: Secure channel for firmware package download from OTA server to TCU.

interfaces.name: TCU-to-Cloud Telemetry Upload
interfaces.description: Encrypted telemetry upload channel for vehicle location, speed, fuel level, and diagnostic data.

interfaces.name: TCU-to-Gateway Internal Link
interfaces.description: Internal Ethernet link between TCU and central gateway for forwarding remote commands to in-vehicle ECUs and receiving vehicle status.

interfaces.name: Gateway-to-Infotainment CAN
interfaces.description: CAN bus connection from gateway to infotainment ECU within the in-vehicle network domain.

interfaces.name: Gateway-to-BCM CAN
interfaces.description: CAN bus connection from gateway to body control module for lock/unlock, window, and lighting commands.

interfaces.name: Gateway-to-Powertrain CAN
interfaces.description: CAN bus connection from gateway to powertrain ECU for engine start/stop and drivetrain commands.

interfaces.name: Diagnostic Tester-to-Gateway OBD-II
interfaces.description: Physical OBD-II port connection for diagnostic tool access to vehicle ECUs via the gateway.

interfaces.name: Cloud Backend Admin Interface
interfaces.description: Administrative web interface for cloud backend management, user administration, and OTA campaign configuration.

interfaces.name: Bluetooth-to-Gateway Diagnostic Link
interfaces.description: Wireless diagnostic channel bridging mobile app or external device to the central gateway via aftermarket OBD dongle.

data_flows.name: User Authentication Request/Response
data_flows.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication flow between mobile app and cloud backend.

data_flows.name: Remote Vehicle Command
data_flows.description: User-initiated vehicle commands (lock, unlock, engine start) sent from mobile app to cloud.

data_flows.name: Cloud-to-TCU Command Relay
data_flows.description: Authenticated vehicle commands forwarded from cloud backend to TCU via MQTT.

data_flows.name: OTA Firmware Package Download
data_flows.description: Signed firmware packages downloaded from OTA server to TCU.

data_flows.name: Vehicle Telemetry Upload
data_flows.description: Periodic upload of vehicle location, speed, fuel, and diagnostic data from TCU to cloud.

data_flows.name: TCU-to-Gateway Command Forward
data_flows.description: Remote commands translated to in-vehicle protocol and forwarded from TCU to gateway.

data_flows.name: Gateway-to-ECU CAN Commands
data_flows.description: CAN messages from gateway to BCM for executing body control commands.

data_flows.name: Gateway-to-Powertrain Commands
data_flows.description: CAN messages from gateway to powertrain ECU for engine management commands.

data_flows.name: Diagnostic Service Requests
data_flows.description: UDS diagnostic service requests and responses between diagnostic tester and ECUs via gateway.

data_flows.name: Security Event Log Upload
data_flows.description: Security event logs forwarded from TCU to cloud backend for centralized monitoring.

assets.name: User Account and Mobile-App Access Token
assets.description: User credentials, OAuth access/refresh tokens, and session state for mobile-app authentication.

assets.name: Cloud Backend API
assets.description: RESTful API endpoints for vehicle command, telemetry, user management, and OTA campaign services.

assets.name: OTA Firmware Package
assets.description: Signed firmware images for ECU updates, including metadata, version info, and cryptographic signatures.

assets.name: Firmware Signing Key and Certificate
assets.description: Private key and X.509 certificate used to sign OTA firmware packages for authenticity verification.

assets.name: Telematics Control Unit (TCU)
assets.description: Vehicle connectivity module handling cellular communication, remote commands, telemetry, and OTA downloads.

assets.name: Central Gateway ECU
assets.description: Central routing and security gateway interconnecting all in-vehicle network domains with firewall policies.

assets.name: CAN/Ethernet Messages and Vehicle Commands
assets.description: In-vehicle bus messages carrying commands, status, and control signals between ECUs.

assets.name: Diagnostic Services and Session Access
assets.description: UDS diagnostic services (read DTC, security access, ECU programming) accessible via OBD-II port.

assets.name: Vehicle Telemetry and Location Data
assets.description: GPS location, speed, fuel level, driving behavior, and diagnostic telemetry collected and uploaded to cloud.

assets.name: Security and Audit Logs
assets.description: Tamper-evident logs of security events, authentication attempts, configuration changes, and anomaly detections.
